note:
Swap the THIRD Key Findings image on /pages/copper-peptide-research. Malcolm's pick, 2026-08-25: gpt_image_02 from the cpr-sat--C-direct-gaze-clinical-blue batch. The slot is key_findings.f3, headed 'Greater satisfaction with skin appearance (independent trial)'.

WHY A PHOTOGRAPH ON THIS BLOCK AND NOT THE OTHER TWO. f1 (Pickart 2018) and f2 (Kang 2009) are measured biology and carry cross-section explainers. f3 (Miller 2006) is SELF-REPORTED satisfaction over 12 weeks - what changed is how the user felt about her own skin. A woman appraising her face with pleasure is a literal depiction of that endpoint; a third mechanism illustration would depict something the study never measured. Malcolm asked for the model shot directly.

WHAT IT REPLACES: skingenetix-philosophy-quality.jpg - a borrowed frame from /pages/our-philosophy that has nothing to do with this finding. Per shopify.md rule 7 the file itself is NOT touched, renamed or re-uploaded: Langify keys translations off the image URL. Only this page's reference changes; the original stays live wherever else it is used.

HONESTY CONSTRAINT ON THE ALT TEXT. She is a model, not a trial participant, and the alt text must not suggest otherwise. It describes the photograph and names the research topic, and stops there. No wording anywhere on the page may present her as evidence.

BOX GEOMETRY - MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED. Live DOM at 390 / 1024 / 1440: the media box is 1:1 at EVERY width (350x350 mobile, 660x660 desktop, capped at 720 by sizes='(max-width: 999px) 100vw, min(720px, 50vw)'), object-fit cover, object-position 50% 50%. A square master is therefore delivered whole and nothing crops. This CONTRADICTS the composition note in page-copper-peptide-research-key-finding-2.json, which claimed the box is taller than wide and crops top and bottom - that was wrong, and no square has ever been cropped in this section.

HANDEDNESS: f3 renders image-LEFT with the text to its right at 1440 (the section alternates media_position: f1 left, f2 right, f3 left). This candidate looks straight down the lens, so it is handedness-neutral and works on either side.

SOURCE FORMAT - A TRAP WORTH RECORDING. The generated master is a 2048px PNG with no EXIF and no ICC profile, which means upload-theme-images.py's optimise() hits its early-return branch ('already web-ready ... left untouched') and hands the uploader PNG BYTES under a .jpg filename, with a Content-Type of image/jpeg guessed from the name. The PNG is therefore converted to JPEG q95 4:4:4 explicitly here, and `source` points at the .jpg. Same settings optimise() would have used had it run - no extra compression, per the measured finding that pre-compressing a source makes the CDN deliver MORE bytes.

ENGINE CHOICE, AND A CORRECTION TO THE INHERITED RECORD. Skin was judged at native 1:1 pixels on the cheek beside the eye, the region where Malcolm rejected the PDRN hero on 2026-08-24. gpt-image, Seedream and NBP Flash all came back CLEAN on this brief - irregular pores of varying size, real moles and freckles at irregular intervals, lines following anatomical directions. Only one candidate carried the machine crepe (A/nbp_pro_02: a dense allover field of near-parallel micro-lines at even density with no pore variation), and a different nbp_pro candidate in the same wave was fine. So the note carried forward from the PDRN round - that nbp_flash, nbp_pro AND seedream all carry the whorl artefact - does not hold as an engine-level trait. It is per-candidate on this brief and must be checked per candidate, not predicted from the supplier.
